verdict.rationale: AI Gateway is API/header-driven by design (OpenAI-compatible endpoint, JSON-based dynamic routing config, header-based controls like cf-aig-cache-status and cf-aig-collect-log), which naturally supports headless/programmatic use in scripts or CI pipelines. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD integration, automation examples, or a CLI for pipeline use. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD workflow examples, dedicated CLI/SDK for automation, documented non-interactive auth/setup flow for pipelines.
